subject: Odyssey Health demo — holding for procurement/security prerequisites
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@odysseyhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Demo planning — quick ask on procurement steps before we lock a live demo

Hi Carlos,

Thanks again for your time yesterday — excited about the potential fit between Redwood and Odyssey Health. Before we lock a 60-minute live demo with our product and solutions teams, a quick ask from our procurement/security side: procurement flagged that Odyssey needs to complete a short vendor onboarding questionnaire and sign an NDA prior to a live technical presentation that will include product architecture and a sample tenant.

I've attached the Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf and a copy of our standard Redwood_NDA_v2.docx for your legal team to review. Typical flow we use for customers in regulated healthcare:
- Customer completes vendor questionnaire (high-level security posture, data residency, retention)
- NDA signed or counter-signed
- If needed, we share a short pre-read and then schedule the demo when procurement clears

If procurement prefers, we can do an abbreviated 20-minute executive overview (no screensharing of a live tenant) while the onboarding form is in-flight — but most customers prefer a pause until the questionnaire/NDA are done. What would work for Odyssey?

Proposed demo window (if procurement clears): Tue 4/20 or Wed 4/21 10:00–11:00 PT. If those don't work, tell me a couple of times that do and I'll get it on the calendar.

Thanks — I cc'd Ben (solutions engineering) and Marissa (technical account lead) so the right folks are lined up when we schedule.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Redwood_NDA_v2.docx

From: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@odysseyhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ana Lopez <procurement@odysseyhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo planning — quick ask on procurement steps before we lock a live demo

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the clear note and the docs. We have two blockers on our side:
1) Procurement requires the completed questionnaire and the signed NDA before a full live tenant demo (they flagged potential PHI-related concerns).
2) Our Chief Product Officer is traveling 4/19–4/22 and would be the primary attendee for the session you proposed.

I've looped Ana from procurement. Ana — can Odyssey provide a target date for completion of the questionnaire and whether you need any supporting evidence (SOC2 report, encryption whitepaper, contact at Red Team)? I've attached our internal procurement checklist (OD_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx) as a reference for your team.

Given the travel window, would you be able to hold the 60-minute demo until the week of 4/26? If procurement can clear earlier we could do a short internal primer the week of 4/19 that doesn't include a live tenant.

Best,
Carlos Ruiz
Senior Director, Platform — Odyssey Health

Attachments: OD_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@odysseyhealth.com>
Cc: Ana Lopez <procurement@odysseyhealth.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2027 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo planning — quick ask on procurement steps before we lock a live demo

Hi Carlos / Ana,

Thanks — totally understand. Ana, to make procurement's work simpler we can provide the following items immediately:
- SOC 2 Type II summary and auditor contact (PDF)
- Short security whitepaper covering data handling and encryption (PDF)
- A filled sample of the vendor questionnaire (we'll pre-populate common fields)

I'll drop the SOC2 summary and the security whitepaper into a shared link; if Ana or procurement would like specific evidence (e.g., encryption key management procedures, asset inventory), Ben can connect with your security lead for a short call.

About scheduling: we can tentatively reserve Tue 4/27 10:00–11:00 PT for the live technical demo (post-clearance) and offer a 20-minute executive primer on Thu 4/22 09:00–09:20 PT that is slide-only (no live data). If that works for Odyssey we will send a mutual action plan (MAP) and a calendar hold.

Attaching a one-page MAP_Redwood-Odyssey.pdf with recommended next steps and owners.

Let me know if you prefer different dates. We can also accept a signed redline NDA if your legal team needs changes — please share it and we'll route to our legal for review.

Thanks,
Soojin

Attachments: MAP_Redwood-Odyssey.pdf

Hello Soojin / Ben / Carlos,

Procurement has completed a first pass. We reviewed the vendor form and the SOC 2 summary — thank you for providing those. We do need an agreed redline to the NDA before Odyssey legal will sign. Attached is our redline (OD_NDA_Redline.docx) with two non-standard clauses (audit access window and subcontractor list) that require your legal team's confirmation.

Once we have agreement on the NDA redline, we are comfortable moving forward with the live demo. We would like to book Tue 4/27 10:00–11:00 PT for the session and request a short pre-demo dry-run with Ben on Mon 4/26 at 09:00 PT to validate SSO and tenant provisioning. Please confirm and send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Ana Lopez

procurement@odysseyhealth.com
